# 3d-target-callout

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Tilted glossy bullseye, tapered beams to numbered pills, single hue. Backdrop: White to pale grey. Items: 3 to 6. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Single hue: family red #E2312A for rings, pills and beams; darker #B5231D on the disc rim and pill shading; white ring gaps, near-black #2B2F36 bullseye
- A brand colour override replaces the red as a single hue; do not cycle colours across pills
- White to pale grey studio backdrop #FFFFFF to #E3E7ED, soft elliptical shadow under the target

## Visual elements

- Target disc 35 to 45 percent of the canvas height, tilted 15 to 25 degrees so the thick rim shows, four to five concentric rings, glossy top-left highlight
- Beams: flat tapered triangles from the bullseye to each pill, wide at the pill, narrow at the centre, never crossing
- Pills: fully rounded rectangles, item hue, white rimmed circle at the inner end with the numeral in the item hue
- Pill text: bold white caps title, light white body text, two lines maximum
- No icons on the pills; the numeral carries wayfinding

## Typography

- Family typography; numerals bold in the item hue on white circles, titles bold white caps, body light white

## Composition rules

- Three to five items: target in the left third, pills stacked on the right (ref 01)
- Six items: target centred, three pills either side, numbered circles facing inward (ref 02)
- More than six items, switch to 3d-capsule-hub or 3d-hex-cluster
- Beams meet at the bullseye; stagger pill heights so beams stay distinct
- Portrait: target at the top, pills stacked below, beams fanning downward

## Layout

### Structure

- Target disc tilted toward the viewer, 35 to 45 percent of the canvas height
- One beam per item from the bullseye to its pill, beams never crossing
- Pills fully rounded, numbered circle at the inner end facing the target
- Pills stacked in one column (three to five items) or split either side (six items)
- Optional closing line under the target for the outcome statement

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Side target** | Three to five goals or criteria | Target left, pills stacked right |
| **Centred target** | Six items in balance | Target centred, three pills per side |
| **Stacked target** | Portrait goal list | Target at the top, pills fanning down |

### Visual elements

- Thick disc rim, four to five concentric rings, dark bullseye
- Tapered flat beams, wide at the pill and narrow at the centre
- Pills in the same single hue as the target, white rimmed numeral circle
- Soft elliptical shadow beneath the target
- No icons; numerals carry the order

### Text placement

- Title at top, left-aligned or centred above the target
- Outcome or goal name on or beside the target
- Pill title in bold white caps, two-line description below in light white
- Numerals in the white circles
- Closing line beneath the target if the layout needs one

## Best for

- Goals, objectives and OKRs
- Success criteria and targets
- Priorities and focus areas
- Strategy pillars aimed at one outcome
